description: This file defines the 'unstable' struct and associated methods for managing 'unstable' log entries and snapshots in the Raft consensus algorithm implementation, including functions for indexing, truncation, stabilization, and snapshot handling.

classes.name: unstable
classes.description: Struct managing unstable log entries and snapshots in Raft.

methods.name: maybeFirstIndex
methods.description: Returns the first possible log index if a snapshot exists.

methods.name: maybeLastIndex
methods.description: Returns the last log index if entries or snapshot exist.

methods.name: maybeTerm
methods.description: Returns the term of the log entry at a given index.

methods.name: nextEntries
methods.description: Returns entries not yet written to storage.

methods.name: nextSnapshot
methods.description: Returns the next snapshot to be written, if any.

methods.name: acceptInProgress
methods.description: Marks current entries and snapshot as in-progress for writing.

methods.name: stableTo
methods.description: Marks entries up to a specific index and term as stable.

methods.name: shrinkEntriesArray
methods.description: Optimizes memory by shrinking the entries slice if underutilized.

methods.name: stableSnapTo
methods.description: Marks a snapshot as stable and clears it.

methods.name: restore
methods.description: Restores unstable log state from a snapshot.

methods.name: truncateAndAppend
methods.description: Truncates log entries before a given index and appends new entries.

methods.name: slice
methods.description: Returns a slice of log entries within a specified range.

methods.name: mustCheckOutOfBounds
methods.description: Checks if slice indices are within valid bounds.
